getting-started.speaker: Khazard Guard
getting-started.text: This area is restricted, leave now!

getting-started.speaker: Khazard Guard
getting-started.text: I don't know you stranger. Get off our land.

getting-started-talking-to-local.speaker: Local
getting-started-talking-to-local.text: Hello stranger, are you new to these parts? You look lost.

getting-started-talking-to-local.speaker: Local
getting-started-talking-to-local.text: I suppose you're here for the fight arena? There are some rich folk fighting tomorrow. Should be entertaining.

getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.player: Hi there. Looks like you're in some trouble.

getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.speaker: Lady Servil
getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil.text: Oh I wish this broken cart was my only problem... I've got to find my family...

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Would you? Please?

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: I'm Lady Servil, my husband is Sir Servil. We were travelling north together with our son Sammy when we were ambushed by General Khazard's men.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: He's been after me ever since I declined his hand in marriage.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Now he's kidnapped my husband and son to fight in his battle arena to the south of here. I hate to think what he'll do to them. He's a sick and twisted man.

steps.player: I'll try my best to return your family.

steps.speaker: Lady Servil
steps.text: Please do. My family is wealthy and can reward you handsomely. I'll be waiting here for you.

steps.player: I hope you can, good luck.

getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil-a.speaker: Lady Servil
getting-started-talking-to-lady-servil-a.text: Brave traveller, please... bring back my family.

entering-the-arena.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena.text: I don't know who you are. Get out of my house stranger.

entering-the-arena-searching-the-armour-.text: If the player has neither helmet nor armour:
If the player does not have the armour:

steps.text: You search the chest, and find the armour of a Khazard guard.

entering-the-arena-searching-the-armour-.text: If the player does not have the helmet:

steps.text: You search the chest, and find the helmet of a Khazard guard.

entering-the-arena-searching-the-armour-.text: If the player has both helmt and armour:

steps.text: You search the chest, but find nothing.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Lady Servil
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Have you had any luck with freeing my family?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.player: I've managed to get a guard's uniform, hopefully I can infiltrate the arena.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Despicable thieving scum, that was good armour. Did you see anyone around here soldier?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Oh, you're a guard as well. That's ok then. We don't like strangers around here.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Local
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: I heard the Servil family are fighting soon. Should be very entertaining.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Local
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Hello stranger, are you new to these parts?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.player: Just visiting friends in the cells.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.speaker: Local
entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.text: Only Khazard guards are allowed to see prisoners. Unless you know where to get some Khazard armour, you won't be visiting anyone.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard barman
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: That'll be two gold coins please.
If the player doesn't have 2 coins:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.text: If the player has 2 coins:

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: There you go, that's two gold coins.{{^|Drops to ground with full inventory.}}

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: If you want to see the action around here you should visit the famous Khazard fight arena. I've seen some grand battles in my time. Ogres, goblins, even dragons have fought there.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: Although you have to feel sorry for some of the slaves sent in there.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: I've never seen you around here before!

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Erm.. yes.. soldier, I take it you're new around here?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Khazard died two hundred years ago. However his dark spirit remains in the form of the undead maniac General Khazard. Remember he is your master, always watching.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.player: Undead, maniac, master. Got it, loud and clear.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.player: This door appears to be locked.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-while-a-.text: Nice observation guard. You could have just asked to be let in like a normal person.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-joe.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Do either of you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: If we did, why would we tell you guard?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: Until our last breath, our every action will be against Khazard. Never will we help you.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-joe.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Do either of you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: I have heard of those of whom you speak. But I fear it may be too late.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: It is said that Khazard has a personal vendetta against those two, their time is therefore short.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: You're a brave [man/woman]. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-kelvin.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Do either of you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: If we did, why would we tell you guard?

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Until our last breath, our every action will be against Khazard. Never will we help you.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-kelvin.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: I have heard of those of whom you speak. But I fear it may be too late.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: It is said that Khazard has a personal vendetta against those two, their time is therefore short.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: You're a brave [man/woman]. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-fightslave.player: Do you know of a Justin or Sammy Servil in this arena?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-fightslave.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: Please leave me alone.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-fightslave.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: I've not met anybody in here by that name.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.player: Do you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.speaker: Hengrad
entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.text: You're not a real guard. I've been in here long enough to know that. What's your business?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.player: I've been sent to rescue Sir Servil and his son.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.speaker: Hengrad
entering-the-arena-talking-to-hengrad.text: I've seen them in here, although they don't look up to much. My advice to you is to leave before you end up in a cell too.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: If the nearby guards are alive:

steps.speaker: Khazard Guard
steps.text: And where do you think you're going? Only General Khazard decides who fights in the arena. Get out of here.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: If the nearby guards are dead:

steps.text: This door appears to be locked.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: Have you come to laugh at the fight slaves? I used to really enjoy it, but after a while they become quite boring.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: Now I just want a decent drink. Mind you, too much Khali brew and I'll fall asleep.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: Bored, bored, bored. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining. Selfish the lot of them.

entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-opening-door-to-the-a.text: I used to enjoy this job, but now all I want is a decent drink.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Sshh. This uniform is a disguise, I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.player: Sshh. I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.speaker: Sammy Servil
entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.text: The guard always keeps hold of them.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.player: Don't lose heart, I'll be back.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-lady-servi.player: Lady Servil, I have managed to infiltrate General Khazard's arena.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard barman
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Hi, what can I get you? We have a range of quality brews.

options.text: I'd like a Khali brew please.

steps.player: I'd like a Khali brew please.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: That'll be five gold coins please.
If the player doesn't have 5 coins:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.speaker: Khazard barman
steps.text: There you go, that's five gold coins. I suggest lying down before you drink it. That way you have less distance to collapse.{{^|Drops to ground with full inventory.}}

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Bored, bored, bored. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining. Selfish the lot of them.* Player: Do you still fancy a drink?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: I really shouldn't... oh... ok then just the one.
You hand a bottle of Khali brew to the guard. He takes a mouthful of the drink.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Blimey this stuff is pretty good. It's not too strong is it?

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.player: No, not at all. You'll be fine.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: The guard quickly finishes the rest of the bottle and begins to sway slightly.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh yeah!

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Yeesshh, hiccup! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.player: Good idea. I'll look after the prisoners.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.text: Yeesh, yes that shounds reasonable. Here, 'hiccup', take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you givem a good beating.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-khazard-ba.player: No problem, I'll keep them in line.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.text: Please, leave me alone. I'm sure the walls never used to sway that much.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.player: Hi, er.. I lost the keys.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.text: ...and I'm drunk. Here, take my spare set.{{^|Drops to floor with full inventory.}}

entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.speaker: Khazard Guard
entering-the-arena-talking-to-drunk-khaz.text: Go away. Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh, 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!

entering-the-arena-using-keys-on-a-cell-.player: The gate is locked, but Sammy's not in there anyway.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.player: Sammy look, I have the keys.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.speaker: Sammy Servil
entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.text: Wow! Please set me free, then we can find my dad. I overheard a guard talking. I think they've taken him to the arena.

entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.speaker: Sammy Servil
entering-the-arena-talking-to-sammy-serv.text: Quick, help him! That beast will kill him. He's too old to fight.
A cutscene plays of a Khazard Ogre exiting a cell toward Justin Servil.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-in-t.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-in-t.text: Quick, help him! That beast will kill him. He's too old to fight.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: General Khazard
steps.text: What do you want guard? I'm a busy man.

steps.speaker: General Khazard
steps.text: In the last two hundred years, I have survived all horrors imaginable. Now it is my turn to cover this land in darkness. One day you shall see, all will quake on hearing my name.

steps.speaker: General Khazard
steps.text: Now leave me.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: General Khazard
steps.text: Who dares enter my home? You? A feeble traveller?

steps.speaker: General Khazard
steps.text: Get out!  Whoever let you in shall be severely punished for this.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil.player: Lady Servil sent me to rescue you and your son. Come on, we have to get out of here.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil.text: I'm too old to fight. I'm afraid you'll have to kill that ogre by yourself.

the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-thr.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-thr.text: Please don't go, you must help us. We'll never survive in here alone.

the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-thr.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-thr.text: Quick, help him! That beast will kill him. He's too old to fight.

the-battles-attacking-general-khazard.text: I don't have time. I'm here to rescue Sir Servil and Sammy.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.player: Lady Servil. I freed your son, however he has returned to the arena to help your husband.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: Oh no, they won't stand a chance. Please go back and help.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: You saved my life and my son's, I am eternally in your debt brave traveller.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Haha, well done, well done that was rather entertaining. I am the great General Khazard, and the two men you just 'saved' are my property.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: Well, I suppose we could find some arrangement for their freedom... hmmm?

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: I'll let them go, but you must stay and fight for me. You'll make me double the gold if you manage to last a few fights.
The player is taken to a jail cell.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-khazard-ogr.text: The General seems to have taken a liking to you. He'd normally kill imposters like you without a second thought.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.text: You saved my life and my son's. I am eternally in your debt brave traveller.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.player: Come on Sammy, we have to get out of here.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.text: Thank you for saving my father.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.text: Haha, well done, well done that was rather entertaining. I am the great General Khazard, and the two men you just 'saved' are my property.

the-battles-exiting-the-arena-after-defe.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-exiting-the-arena-after-defe.text: Haha, well done, well done that was rather entertaining. I am the great General Khazard, and the two men you just 'saved' are my property.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.player: I have come to demand the release of Sir Servil and his son.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.text: Why would I give them up, those two men are my property now.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-in-the-jail.text: Sammy is in the arena with his father now.

the-battles-talking-to-fightslave-after-.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: Please leave me alone.

the-battles-talking-to-fightslave-after-.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: Why am I here?

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: What did I do to deserve this?

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: Please help me.

steps.speaker: Fightslave
steps.text: You're not safe here, leave while you can.

the-battles-talking-to-fightslave-after-.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-talking-to-fightslave-after-.text: General Khazard doesn't tolerate the lazy. If you're not keeping busy I'll practice my combat skills on your hide.

the-battles-talking-to-joe-after-killing.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Get away, get away. One day I'll have my revenge, and I'll have all your heads.

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: Spare me your fake pity. I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.

the-battles-talking-to-joe-after-killing.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: You're not safe here traveller. Leave while you still can

steps.speaker: Joe
steps.text: You're a brave person. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.

the-battles-talking-to-kelvin-after-kill.text: If the player has the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: Get away, get away. One day I'll have my revenge, and I'll have all your heads.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: Spare me your fake pity. I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.

the-battles-talking-to-kelvin-after-kill.text: If the player does not have the Khazard armour equipped:

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: You're not safe here traveller. Leave while you still can

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.text: You're a brave person. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: So Khazard got his hands on you too?

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: If you're lucky you may last as long as me.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.player: How long have you been here?

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: I've been in Khazard's prisons ever since I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-in-the-ja.text: Wait.. sshh, the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going into the arena. Good luck friend.
The guard walks up and unlocks the cell.
The player is brought into the arena.
From above you hear a voice.....  'Ladies and gentlemen! Let today's first fight between the outsider and everyone's favourite scorpion commence.'
The scorpion exits the cell and attacks the player.

the-battles-entering-the-building-after-.player: This door appears to be locked.

the-battles-entering-the-building-after-.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-entering-the-building-after-.text: So you're back for more are you? General Khazard will be pleased.
(The player is taken directly to the arena.)

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-in-t.player: Don't worry, I'll get us out of here.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-in-t.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-in-t.text: Thanks traveller. I'm sorry that you too are now a subject of this arena.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-in-.player: Don't worry, I'll get us out of here.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-in-.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-in-.text: You've incurred the anger of Khazard yourself now. He won't let any of us go easily.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-d.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-d.text: How dare you speak to me, you are a slave of this arena now.

the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-dur.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-trying-to-exit-the-arena-dur.text: It would be impolite to leave now. The General insists you stay a little longer.

the-battles-upon-killing-the-scorpion.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-the-scorpion.text: Not bad, not bad at all. I think you need a tougher challenge. Time for my puppy. Guards! Guards! Bring on Bouncer!
From above you hear a voice.....  'Ladies and gentlemen! Today's second round of battle is between the outsider and Bouncer.'

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-dur.player: Come on, we only have to fight a creature called bouncer now.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-dur.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-dur.text: You may laugh, but the name of the General's 'pet' is feared by many in this land.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-dur.player: Don't worry, I'll get us out of here.

the-battles-talking-to-the-local-during-.speaker: Local
the-battles-talking-to-the-local-during-.text: Hey you're the guy from the arena! How'd you get out!

the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-during-th.speaker: Hengrad
the-battles-talking-to-hengrad-during-th.text: I don't know how you managed to escape the arena, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: Nooooo! Bouncer! How dare you? You've taken the life of my only friend. Now you'll suffer traveller, prepare to meet your maker.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.player: You agreed to let the Servils go if I stayed to fight.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: Indeed. I obviously underestimated you, although you still pale in comparison to the might of General Khazard.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: You shall see that I am not cowardly enough to make false promises. They may go.

the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-upon-killing-bouncer.text: You however have caused me much trouble today. You must remain here so that I may at least have the pleasure of killing you myself.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.player: What does Khazard want with us now?

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.text: I don't know, but I can't imagine he'll be happy with you now.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.text: The agreement was that the Servils may leave if you won a few fights, and indeed they are now free to do so.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.player: What does Khazard want with us now?

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.text: I don't know, but he won't be happy that you've killed his so called pet.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.text: The agreement was that the Servils may leave if you won a few fights, and indeed they are now free to do so.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.player: You can run, Khazard's interest is in me now.

the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.speaker: Justin Servil
the-battles-talking-to-justin-servil-aft.text: My thanks, we'll be ok now. I suggest you run too, General Khazard is mighty and his anger fearsome.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.player: You and your father should run, Khazard's interest is in me now.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.speaker: Sammy Servil
the-battles-talking-to-sammy-servil-afte.text: I'm sorry to have gotten you into so much trouble. You should run as well, Khazard is too dangerous.

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.text: You killed my pet, and yet still you dare to speak to me?

the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.speaker: General Khazard
the-battles-talking-to-general-khazard-a.text: You shall die for your insolence.

the-battles-entering-the-door-to-the-bui.player: This door appears to be locked.

the-battles-entering-the-door-to-the-bui.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-entering-the-door-to-the-bui.text: You're [him/her]. The one who murdered the General's pet.

the-battles-opening-the-door-to-the-aren.speaker: Khazard Guard
the-battles-opening-the-door-to-the-aren.text: You're the one who killed Bouncer.

the-battles-talking-to-sammy-in-the-cell.text: You've already rescued Sammy from the fight arena.

the-battles-talking-to-the-local-after-k.speaker: Local
the-battles-talking-to-the-local-after-k.text: You're the guy who beat Bouncer, amazing!

the-battles-talking-to-the-local-after-k.speaker: Local
the-battles-talking-to-the-local-after-k.text: That makes you a champion to many, but you'd better get out of here while you still can. General Khazard liked that brute.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: You're alive, I thought Khazard's men had taken you.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: My son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. I am truly grateful for your service.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: All I can offer in return is material wealth. Please take these coins as a sign of my gratitude.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: You're alive, I thought Khazard's men had taken you.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: My son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. I am truly grateful for your service.

the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.speaker: Lady Servil
the-battles-talking-to-lady-servil-after.text: All I can offer in return is material wealth. Please take these coins as a sign of my gratitude.

post-quest-talking-to-lady-servil-after-.speaker: Lady Servil
post-quest-talking-to-lady-servil-after-.text: Oh hello my dear. My husband and son are resting while I wait for the cart fixer.

post-quest-talking-to-lady-servil-after-.player: I hope he's not too long.
